integrity: Positive-support independence eliminates label 1. Every feasible positive support is then an independent dominating set, and the nested half-graph neighborhoods force it to be exactly one canonical cut set. The leaf or cut-boundary zeros force one or two label-3 vertices, after which all remaining positive labels are independently 2 or 3. This gives the complete enumerator directly.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to half graphs with n at least two.
Finite exhaustive verification covers n from two through five and is corroborative only.
The earliest 2019 preprint was available through abstract and bibliographic metadata rather than full text in the accessible sources.
A differently phrased or non-indexed half-graph enumeration may exist.
title: Independent double Roman weight enumerator of half graphs
